title: Skin Cancer Detection in Primary Care With and Without DermaSensor
official: Improving Skin Cancer Detection With AI-Assisted Triage in Healthcare: A Real-World, Multi-Center, Randomized Controlled Trial (INSIGHT-RCT)
summary: This randomized controlled trial evaluates whether primary care physician access to the DermaSensor device increases the proportion of patients with histopathology-confirmed skin cancer compared with physician standard clinical assessment alone. Participating physicians are randomized and outcomes are drawn from existing electronic health record data for up to 500,000 patient encounters.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Practicing primary care provider in the labeled user population for the DermaSensor device (per the Instructions for Use)
* Practicing at a participating site that uses an EMR system modifiable at the user level
* Practicing at a participating site that routinely documents skin check data, including coding for skin checks and lesion diagnoses
* Practicing at a participating site where pathology results for patients referred to dermatology are routinely accessible for study analyses

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Not actively practicing in primary care at a participating study site
